ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Based on the partial food web diagram, algae are classified as what?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows a partial food web. In the lower left there is a box labeled “Algae”, with green aquatic plant-like organisms drawn inside; it is located near the lower part of the food web, and nearby there are other organisms such as fish, plants, ducks, and ants. The question asks what classification algae belongs to in the food web. According to food web rules, algae can make their own food through photosynthesis and are at the basic trophic level of the food web, so they are not consumers but producers.
